rules.discoveries: new targets can appear mid-mission; a target_discovered event in the telemetry packet for its appear tick announces it, so it arrives delay_ticks later, and map() lists it from then on
rules.energy_order: idle drain, then command; drive costs per wheel metre
rules.first_execution_tick: sent_tick + delay_ticks + 1; FIFO, one command per tick
rules.heading: 0 degrees east, 90 north
rules.reward: sum over sampled targets of value if the sample executed at or before deadline_tick, otherwise value * late_fraction; times 1 at base, 0.5 alive elsewhere, 0 if dead; scored at the horizon
rules.safety_stop: at a hazard or map edge, stop at last safe position and clear queued commands; reservations remain

sample_windows.deadline: deadline_tick per target in map(); null means no deadline

rules.sampling: pay sampling cost; collect the nearest unsampled active target within target_radius; a discovered target is active from its appear tick
rules.slip_model: clip(terrain coefficient + per-drive noise, 0, 0.9); noise is fixed by seed and execution tick
rules.telemetry_arrival_tick: state_tick + delay_ticks; tick 0 is the initial briefing
